headline: The president should lead national campaigns instead of inaugurating works.
author: The Commercial does not necessarily agree with columnists' opinions but respects them.
content: To convince or overcome resistance requires leadership and explanation. High approval helps. Unfortunately, this level is dropping despite concessions. People desire strong governance pursuing clear objectives rather than weak ones targeting obstructors. To regain popularity, focus on major crusades using media support.

headline: Weakened immunity session postponed again
author: Rocio Laura Vasquez
content: President of Congress's Immunity Committee Elias Rodriguez justified lack of quorum during yesterday’s meeting intended to discuss Supreme Court request against lawmaker Ricardo Acuna. He denied intentions to shield Acuna stating 'It was almost certain suspension because representation week.' Only two members attended out of seven required.

headline: Simsualcro National Earthquake and Tsunami Exercise Shows Improved Participation
content: According to INDECI, more than eight million students participated along with 60 percent citizens compared to last year's 45 percent participation rate. This reflects increased commitment towards disaster preparedness following historical events like May 31st, 1970 earthquake and landslide affecting Ancash.

headline: Arequipa paralyzed by protests
content: Transportation strike announced for June 5th after massive disruptions including school closures and halted services across various sectors. Protest sparked by ISC increase and fuel price hikes led to non-participation in nationwide drill scheduled since morning hours.

headline: Project aims to legalize collective taxis
author: Josefin Miranda Quispe
content: Roy Ventura discusses necessity yet challenges of passing legislation aimed at regulating transportation without sufficient oversight capacity leading potentially to congestion issues. Emphasizes need for detailed regulation defining operational limits and safety standards before law enactment can succeed.

headline: Lima bridges corruption indicators found
subheadline: Rolley Reyma/Karla Ramirez Camarena Unit Investigation
author: Jessica Vicente
content: Contraloria reports indicate potential corruption involving bridge constructions managed by EMAPA showing preferential treatment toward specific contractors resulting in structural vulnerabilities exposed during recent natural disasters.

headline: Mural project revitalizing streets in Miraflores
author: Alex Senna/Jessica Vicente
content: Miraflores district hosts its inaugural mural festival aiming to enhance community identity through artistic expression supported by civic organizations promoting drug-free initiatives alongside urban beautification efforts.

author: Rolley Reyna
content: Sub-officer accused of homicide related to disappearance case where victim reportedly met his end near association premises followed by discovery of mutilated vehicle nearby suggesting involvement beyond initial assumptions.
